scope: Create a source-bound complete Codex consolidation plan and census in own sibling; no merge, main movement, runtime change, or execution dispatch.

criticality.rationale: Verified Codex work is fragmented while shared main is evolving.

stpa.rationale: Rewriting peer candidates or accepting stale evidence is a critical UCA without mandatory JJ fences.

fmea.rationale: S4 O3 Det3 RPN36 band4: unreviewed consolidation can lose changes or falsely accept a release.

dependency.rationale: Authoritative census and gate ordering are required before any consolidation wave.

impact.rationale: One plan covers several Codex subsystem work streams and shared integration.

fmea_modes.cause: Mutable labels, incomplete workspace inventory or stale test association.
fmea_modes.effect: Omitted unique code, lost provenance or false clearance of shared main.
fmea_modes.controls: Pin operation/commit identity, include every Codex workspace, require owner freeze and candidate-bound tests, serialize integration under lease.

stpa_analysis.controller: Plan author and future serialized integration controller
stpa_analysis.control_action: Specify complete provenance-preserving consolidation with gated mainline updates.

ucas.context: Unique workspace work is omitted from the merge census.
ucas.constraint: Inventory workspaces, bookmarks, candidate receipts and attribution gaps.

ucas.context: Plan is mistaken for automatic mainline or deployment authorization.
ucas.constraint: Keep this task planning-only; activate execution separately through Sa-plan.

ucas.context: Candidate or main moves after evidence is collected.
ucas.constraint: Revalidate commit/operation identity, ownership and gates at each wave.

ucas.context: Integration reservation blocks unrelated work or validation runs indefinitely.
ucas.constraint: Bound checks; hold integration/main only during authorized serialized landing.

decision.summary: Plan selective, verified consolidation from exact source objects; avoid blindly merging historical or superseded work.
alternatives: Merge all bookmarks in one change: rejected because ancestry, authorship and evidence differ.
Merge only named Codex bookmarks: rejected because unique workspace-only changes could be omitted.
Create a full pinned census and dependency-gated wave plan: selected.
counterevidence: Thirteen explicit Codex heads already occur in observed main ancestry.
Six Codex changes have divergent versions; executable bookmark differs from retained test package.
Canonical Sa-plan binary CLI advertises0.3.0 while current source advertises0.4.0; execution needs an authority/tool receipt.
assumptions: Only plan creation is requested now.
Other workspaces are read-only evidence; no source freezes or merges are performed.
decision.forecast: Most historical bookmarks require coverage receipts; a smaller set needs actual source integration after evidence reconciliation.
decision.falsifier: Census misses a Codex workspace, proposed wave replays an already covered patch, or an activated task changes main without fresh gates.
acceptance: Every observed Codex workspace and bookmark classified
Exact candidate list and difference paths attached
Dependency order, rollback and acceptance gates specified
Canonical planning task and repository plan/journal recorded; no integration dispatch
decision.rollback: Abandon only own plan changes if required; no application or mainline rollback is needed.
decision.reviewer: Author self-review; independent execution review remains required.
decision.budget: One worker, no subagents, installs or external models; bounded read-only JJ/file inspections, documentation and own task coordination only.
residuals: Owner-frozen dirty work and exact semantic supersession require execution-stage evidence.
Planning validation does not repair production or grant admission.
decision.supersedes: New consolidation planning request; previous manual UI task remains closed.
